New entities now show their hitbox in the ESP like the older ones (toggle: Show Hitbox on New Entities)
Alma, Creak and Bramble notify; Alma and Creak ESP; Highlight Other Threats toggle for scanner-tagged entities
Drones, Drones Stampede, Teller, Bash and Scribbles are now in the Entity ESP and Entity Notify lists
Archives ESP now uses the real names: Drones, DronesStampede, TellerEntity, BashMoving, Scribbles (also scans LiveEntities)
Archives ESP: broader name guesses and a Label All New Models discovery toggle
Archives ESP: fixed default entity selection, added A60/A90/A120 internal names, model name logger
Archives and Stairwell entity ESP and notifications (name-matched, with a debug print toggle)
Abyss theme as the new default, plus Rose, Ember, Mint, Violet, Mono and AMOLED
Quick tab: config presets and pinned favorite toggles
Notification types with icons, and a mute toggle in Settings
Groupbox icons and a smaller window on mobile
Rounded window, smoother fade, redesigned notifications
Loader retries failed downloads and reports errors
Notifications moved into their own module
